sourceName: EC JRC PVGIS v5.2 PVcalc (PVGIS-NSRDB satellite irradiance)
attributionNote: Irradiance source is NREL's National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB PSM, years 2005-2015) accessed through PVGIS; temperature data ERA5; simulation is PVGIS's own PV model.
rawFieldMeaning: Annual AC energy (kWh/year) of the specified PV system.
transformation: Standard 4 kW crystalline-Si system, fixed mounting, tilt 20deg, south-facing (aspect 0), 14% total losses; E_y rounded to 2 decimals.
limitation: County-centroid simulation for relative feasibility comparison across counties; not a site-specific design and not an NREL PVWatts result.
license: Free reuse with attribution (EC-JRC PVGIS terms)
adjustments: 48007 (Aransas County): offshore centroid moved inland 15% toward (31.05, -99.14)
48167 (Galveston County): offshore centroid moved inland 15% toward (31.05, -99.14)
48261 (Kenedy County): offshore centroid moved inland 15% toward (31.05, -99.14)
